findings.problem: The hint's word 'defeat' points straight at besiegen (to defeat), which is also a common right answer for beating an opponent, so the prompt has two right answers.
findings.fix: hint: win against a team or rival, as in we beat them 3 to 1; the everyday word, not besiegen

back.target: to beat, to defeat (an opponent); also to hit, to strike
back.example: We beat them three to one.

note: No Spanish card means to defeat: ganar-win is to win and golpear-hit is to hit, so null is correct.
